value.task: Analyze the identified failed run using only evidence you actually read. Choose what logs and frozen sources to inspect. Propose a complete component replacement only if the evidence distinguishes one faulty implementation from its callers, dependencies, contracts, and input; otherwise abstain and identify the missing evidence. Do not assume that any source you inspect is faulty.

phases.instruction: Choose and read only evidence that can distinguish a responsible component. Return an evidence summary when ready to complete.
Complete from retained evidence. Use at most one final debug.nav read only if a decisive fact is still missing, then call exactly one repair terminal action.

agent.result_instruction: During investigation, use debug.nav and return an evidence summary when ready. In the final phase, make at most one last evidence read if necessary, then call exactly one top-level repair.terminal/abstain or repair.terminal/propose action; the action completes the report itself, so do not wrap it in return.
